title: System Design
description: Learn to design software systems step by step: first functional requirements (what a system must do), then non-functional requirements (how well it must do it).

chapters.title: Functional Requirements
chapters.description: What must the system do? Discover, write and check functional requirements, then use them in design and interviews.

chapters.title: Non-Functional Requirements
chapters.description: How well must the system work? Make qualities such as availability, latency and security measurable, weigh trade-offs, and use them in design and interviews.
